tasks.short: Negotiate workable creditor payment adjustments for clients.

steps.what: Review the actual debt balance, payment history and existing creditor correspondence
Confirm client priorities, affordability limits and authority to negotiate
Negotiate payment adjustments, interest reductions or extensions within the actual client mandate
Write and check actual negotiated terms, mandate limits and outstanding client decisions
Save the checked actual negotiation record

tasks.design: Configure the existing {CRM} case view to bring dated creditor correspondence and payment history together, retaining source reading. Keep mandate confirmation, actual creditor negotiation and outcome writing human; save the checked actual record separately through the existing control.
tasks.previous_blocker: Case navigation fragments the context needed before a creditor conversation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native related-record views can reduce navigation without generating offers or interpreting authority.
tasks.still_hard: Creditors may reject affordable terms; a view cannot negotiate acceptance.
tasks.human_edge: The counselor protects the clients interests and judges concessions against the real mandate.
tasks.altitude: Less case navigation; decision rights and negotiation responsibility stay unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native case views can show related dated records without replacing negotiation.

assumptions: Boundary is counselor labour from reviewing an existing case through recording actual negotiation. Creditor and client labour is not included or reduced.
Existing case records are produced by prior actual payment processing and counselor correspondence capture; no structured new input is free. Missing or mismatched records are read manually in s1.
Shares are provisional task allocations, not measured baselines. Native configuration is tested first; existing runtime earns no saving.
The 1 percent save is schema granularity and fully retained. Checking is the existing accuracy check while writing, not extra approval work. No terms outside the actual client mandate are accepted.
unknowns: Whether the current case view already links these records
research_questions: Does a case sample show navigation that the native related-record view removes?

incremental.description: Check related-record links and access changes

approvals.approved_version: s4 complete checked actual negotiation record for the identified client case

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional native context view reduces ten navigation units by 40 percent: four gross points minus 0.5 upkeep = 3.5. Half that benefit gives 1.5. Negotiation and actual record writing and save retain full effort; if already linked, do not introduce the change.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Research options to prevent repossession or resolve levies and garnishments.

steps.what: Establish actual client facts, enforcement stage and the research question
Locate current authoritative debt and enforcement resources using native source filters
Read source provisions and verify jurisdiction, status, deadlines and actual applicability
Assess feasible client options and questions requiring specialist legal advice
Write and check source-linked findings, limitations and urgent unresolved questions
Save the checked research note in the client case

tasks.design: Use native jurisdiction, topic and date filters in {OTHER}, an authoritative legal and debt-resource database. Retain all source reading, applicability judgement and substantive research writing; save the checked source-linked findings in {CRM} without treating research as a legal filing or an achieved enforcement remedy.
tasks.previous_blocker: Relevant resources are spread across topics and jurisdictions.
tasks.enabler_now: Maintained native source searches can reduce finding time without a model interpreting legal effects.
tasks.still_hard: Actual enforcement stage and exceptions determine whether an option is relevant.
tasks.human_edge: The counselor recognises when uncertainty or urgency requires a qualified specialist.
tasks.altitude: Less searching; legal and advice authority remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: authoritative research databases commonly support topic and jurisdiction filters; source applicability still needs professional reading.

assumptions: Boundary is research on an existing actual client case through its written findings; actual remedies, legal submissions and separate client advice are not silently automated.
The counselor checks notices and facts in s1; the database publisher supplies indexed resources. No structured extraction is assumed. Missing index fields require manual search in s2.
Shares and reduction are provisional. Existing native searches yield no new benefit; no new legal conclusion is asserted.
The existing writing accuracy check covers the final note save; 1 percent action share is schema granularity with full retained effort.
unknowns: Licensed authoritative resources and native filter coverage
research_questions: Does jurisdiction and topic filtering find the correct resources without excluding relevant exceptions?

incremental.description: Maintain saved resource searches and check dead source links

approvals.approved_version: s5 complete checked source-linked research note for the actual client case

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional source-finding reduction: 20 units at 50 percent = ten gross points minus one upkeep = nine. Half eligible search benefit gives four. Source reading, applicability judgement and writing are unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Disburse authorised client funds to the correct creditors.

steps.what: Verify client authority, available funds, creditor details and agreed payment amounts
Prepare the creditor payment batch from checked client instructions
Check and authorise the complete final payment batch against the client mandate
Release the authorised final creditor payments through the bank
Verify actual settlement, rejected payments and any held funds
Reconcile and check actual creditor payments against the client account record
Commit the checked actual creditor payment allocations

tasks.design: Test the native payment export from {CRM} and draft import in {BANK} before building an integration. Reuse checked payment fields without re-keying, retain complete batch authorisation and separate release, then verify actual settlement before writing and committing actual allocations.
tasks.previous_blocker: A checked payment plan may be re-keyed into the banking draft.
tasks.enabler_now: Supported payment exports and bank draft imports can reuse exact instructions without making payment decisions.
tasks.still_hard: Wrong beneficiary details, insufficient funds and rejected transactions require investigation.
tasks.human_edge: The authorised counselor checks the clients mandate and does not confuse submission with settlement.
tasks.altitude: Less payment preparation; spending authority remains unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: supported bank payment imports can prepare drafts from structured authorised payment instructions.

assumptions: Boundary is a counselor already authorised to disburse funds, from checking a standing client mandate through actual allocation records. No authority or extra signer is invented; retain the organisations existing additional bank signers if required and measure their labour separately.

Prior plan maintenance produces client account ID, creditor beneficiary ID, independently verified account details, amount, currency, due date and reference; s1 checks them against the mandate and balance. Missing or changed fields are entered and verified manually in s2, whose retained time counts that fallback.
Bank settlement records are actual returned results, never inferred from release. Rejected or held items stay unresolved in s5 and s6.

Provisional shares assume actual re-keying in s2; if already native, claim no benefit. Runtime and routine release or commit earn zero saving. Their 1 percent shares are schema granularity, not measured click costs.
unknowns: Existing disbursement authority and bank signing rules
Native export and draft import compatibility
research_questions: Can a test batch preserve beneficiary, amount, mandate linkage and reference through the native draft import?

incremental.description: Check payment mapping changes and reconcile failed draft imports

approvals.approved_version: s3 complete final payment batch with exact beneficiaries amounts references and source mandate
s6 complete checked actual allocation record tied to actual bank results

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional 25-unit re-key preparation step retains 40 percent, saving 15 points minus two upkeep = 13. Half eligible imports save 7.5 minus two = 5.5. All mandate checks, release, actual status checks, reconciliation and commit retain full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Investigate missing, held or returned payments to resolve account problems.

steps.what: Identify the disputed payment and retrieve actual client, creditor and bank records
Capture and check references, dates, amounts, statuses and source identities
Compare payment histories and flag explicit missing, returned or held-status discrepancies
Investigate discrepancies with client or creditor and determine the actual cause and resolution
outputs: actual agreed resolution or unresolved question

steps.what: Write and check actual payment findings, resolution status and unresolved next actions
inputs: actual agreed resolution or unresolved question

steps.what: Save the checked actual payment investigation record

tasks.design: Configure exact-reference joins and discrepancy views in the existing {SPREADSHEET}, using separately checked actual bank and case fields. Keep source collection, ambiguous matching, client or creditor investigation and actual resolution writing human; the separately saved {CRM} outcome does not initiate a replacement payment.
tasks.previous_blocker: The counselor compares fragmented histories by reference and amount.
tasks.enabler_now: Native joins and status comparisons can expose explicit mismatches without deciding their cause.
tasks.still_hard: A missing or reused reference can leave the cause unresolved despite a matching amount.
tasks.human_edge: The counselor distinguishes actual settlement evidence from explanations or promises.
tasks.altitude: Less exact matching; responsibility for resolution and any separate payment decision is unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native spreadsheet joins can compare checked payment references and display explicit status discrepancies.

assumptions: Boundary is investigation of actual disputed payments through an outcome record. A new disbursement or ledger correction is a separate authorised workflow, never implied by a discrepancy flag.

The counselor produces and checks client ID, creditor ID, payment reference, amount, currency, transaction date, actual status and source ID in s2. Missing or ambiguous identifiers stay in manual investigation s4 rather than guessed matches.
All collection, original capture, discussions and actual findings writing retain full time. No conversation transcript or hidden structured input is assumed.

Shares are provisional. Native comparison is tested first; an already configured view earns no benefit. The fully retained 1 percent save is schema granularity and the existing accuracy check in s5 covers its final version.
unknowns: Actual quality of common payment references
Time spent on exact comparisons versus missing evidence
research_questions: Do sampled disputes contain reliable shared references that allow exact comparison without false matches?

incremental.description: Maintain comparison mappings and inspect unmatched reference patterns

approvals.approved_version: s5 complete checked actual investigation record with actual resolution status

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional exact comparison saves 20 points minus 1.5 upkeep = 18.5. Half eligible histories give ten minus 1.5 = 8.5. Collection, field capture, conversations, resolution writing and save remain full effort.
